    # find non-background cells: background is the most common color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==col]
    rs=[r for r,c in seed]; cs=[c for r,c in seed]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1,c1=max(rs),max(cs)
    cells=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in seed]
